verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a provider-agnostic API that shields clients from provider-specific APIs, but nothing says tool or function calls are normalized into a consistent schema across providers. The MCP Proxy turns REST APIs into MCP tools, which is a different capability from cross-provider LLM function-call normalization, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can make tool and function calls across different providers with a consistent schema
